rows.en: I checked whether he was breathing
I checked whether his heart was beating

{f:I|I} held my hand over Arai's face.
It was faint, but he was breathing.
Had moving his body turned out to be a good thing after all?
Arai's eyelids twitched.
He had come back to life.
But just then, a thought struck {f:me|me}.{p}

What would Arai think if he came to and saw what was going on?
It didn't look like we were taking him to a hospital.
What if he found out we'd been about to carry him to the incinerator?
Arai would be furious.
He might report {f:us|us} to the police.
That would be a disaster!
The blood rushed to my head.{p}

There was a fire extinguisher in the corner of the hallway.
The instant I caught sight of it, {f:I|I} stopped knowing what I was doing.{p}

…………When I came to my senses, {f:I|I} was clutching a bloodstained fire extinguisher.
Arai lay in front of me, drenched in blood.
He had to be dead for real this time.
As {f:I|I} stood there thinking that in a daze, Kazama rounded on me.
"What were you thinking?! He'd finally come back to life!
You're the one who killed him, you hear me?!"
Before Kazama could finish, a voice called from down the hallway.
"What are you doing there★"
It was the teacher on night duty.
Kazama shouted at the top of his lungs, as if he'd forgotten whose side he'd been on a moment ago.
"It's terrible! Please, come quickly☆"
……{f:I|I} had become a murderer.
I couldn't even bring myself to resent Kazama.
Nothing mattered anymore……{p}{f:I|I} didn't even try to run. I just watched the teacher hurrying toward me.{p}

{f:I|I} pressed my ear to Arai's chest.
It was wheezing.
Had he really come back to life {f:after all|after all}?
The very next moment, I realized that was impossible.
When we'd checked earlier, Arai had definitely been dead.
And then there was this sound.
If it were breathing, it couldn't be coming from inside his chest{f:!|!}
What on earth {f:was|was} this sound★
{f:We|We} looked at each other.
The thing lying there no longer seemed like Arai. It seemed like something far more evil.
I had to run.
I had to get away from this place.{p}

An instant before {f:I|I} could break into a run, Kazama's voice rang out sharply.
"{f:We've come this far|Sorry}, and I won't let you run away now.
Come on, take that arm."
His eyes were dead serious.
If I defied him, {f:I|I} might end up killed too.{p}

Fighting back nausea, {f:I|I} lifted the arm.
Taking turns as we went, how long did it take us to reach the incinerator?{p}

Of course, the fire in the incinerator had gone out.
Kazama took out a lighter.{p}

He lit the incinerator.
The fire flared up and writhed like a living thing.
"Now, put him in here."
Lit by the glare of the flames, Kazama's face looked like a devil's as he said it.
{f:We|We} couldn't refuse. We threw Arai's body into the incinerator.
A shower of sparks shot up.
{f:We|We} had truly become criminals.
This morning we'd still been ordinary high school students……
None of it felt real, and my head was spinning.{p}

Kazama was trying to shut the incinerator door.
But the hinges were stiff and it wouldn't close.
"Tch, what's wrong with this thing……"
He muttered it and leaned in to look. And at that moment...{p}

Arai's upper body lunged out of the incinerator!
The fire had already caught his hair and shirt.
His face covered in blisters, Arai grinned.
Then he wrapped his arms tight around Kazama and dragged him into the flames!{p}

Kazama's scream rang out.
What should I do?
Save Kazama
Save Arai

{f:I|I} chose Kazama.
I grabbed his sleeve and pulled with all my might.{p}

Arai, a human torch, glared at {f:me|me}.
A chill ran down my spine.
Those weren't the eyes of a living person.
Arai pulled back with tremendous strength.
Instead, I was nearly dragged in myself.
But just then, someone grabbed {f:my belt|my arm}.
That gave me courage, and {f:I|I} pulled with everything I had.
Suddenly, the force on the other end vanished.
The recoil sent {f:us|us} tumbling to the ground, Kazama and all.
Arai's arm had burned {f:off|off}.
Wrapped in flames, Arai stared at {f:me|me} with resentment.
Then, slowly, he was swallowed by the raging fire…………{p}

Kazama's burns weren't serious.
If we kept quiet, Arai would {f:probably|surely} just be listed as missing.
……There {f:was|was} no other way.
{f:We|We} left the school without a word.
Tomorrow, the day after, and every day after that, {f:we|we} would surely keep our silence.
{f:We|We} knew that silence was the only way to protect ourselves.
…………That should have been the end of it.
But.
Something {f:happened|happened} that wouldn't let it end.
Arai is angry with {f:me|me}.
I wondered why it was {f:me|me} and not Kazama……
I'm sure Arai {f:must have believed|had believed} that {f:I|I} was on his side.
That's why he's angry that {f:I|I} helped Kazama{f:.|.}
Maybe he feels betrayed.
In his anger, Arai…………latched onto {f:me|me}.
Day and night, he clings to {f:me|me} and won't leave.
To people who don't believe in ghosts, he {f:probably seems|must seem} like nothing but a hallucination born of my guilt over him.
But that's not what he is.
{f:I|I} know…… only {f:I|I} know.
No, anyone with even a little sixth sense {f:should|should} be able to see him.
After all, even now he's right here beside me.{p}
……See?{p}

{f:So|So} Arai wasn't dead after all?
{f:I|I} shoved Kazama aside and grabbed Arai's arm.{p}

"Get out of there, Arai, hurry!"
Arai looked at {f:me|me}.
The next moment, Arai's arm crumbled and dropped off.
The inside of the arm was hollow.{p}

They were diving into the blazing fire.
A few of them, still on fire, came flying at {f:me|me}.
{f:Stop it|Stop}, {f:get away from me|don't come near me}!
The burning bugs singed {f:my|my} hair.
Someone grabbed my flailing arm.{p}

It was Kazama{f:!|!}
The burns had changed his face.
His hate-filled eyes glared at {f:me|me}.
You're coming with me.
I thought I heard a voice say it.
Where he gripped my arm, it gave off the sickening smell of sizzling flesh.
Bug after bug, turned to fireballs, slammed into me and set my {f:shirt|uniform} alight.
The roar of flames swirling around my ears drowned out everything.
{f:I|I} was engulfed in flames.{p}

I still couldn't think of anything to say that would stop a fight between upperclassmen.
While {f:I|I} hesitated, one of the girls marched right up to them.
"Stop it, both of you!
If you're going to keep this up, I'll have to ask you to leave right now."
Her firm tone {f:seemed|seemed} to take the fight right out of both Kazama and Arai.
{f:When guys lose their cool|Good}, {f:a word from a girl really works|I'll say something too}.
"That's right. We're here today so you can tell us about the seven wonders."
{f:My words just hung in the air|Everyone nodded}.
{f:Looks like I wasn't needed|If only the two of them would stay calm now}.
That seemed to settle Kazama down a little.{p}

"Honestly. This is hardly the sort of thing someone like me should be talking about seriously."
Apparently he had no intention of taking this seven-wonders business seriously.
"Let's just drop it! All this stupid talk."
With that, he threw his hands up theatrically.{p}

"I do understand Kazama's point.
After all, if people were asked whether spirits and such really exist, how many could boldly answer, 'They do'……
It can't be helped.
At this point, I'll simply have to show you."
Arai said it quietly.
Glancing sideways at Kazama, he slowly rose to his feet.
Kazama fell silent, as if he'd given up.
"Everyone, please stay seated and watch."
Everyone did as Arai said.
"Thank you.
{a}{f:|}, would you mind turning off the lights?"{p}

{f:I|I} turned off the lights and sat back down.
Maybe no one wanted to cause any more trouble; everyone sat quietly in their chairs.
Arai closed his eyes, apparently concentrating with all his might.
Just as he'd promised, he showed {f:us|us} something supernatural.{p}
Arai's body {f:had begun to glow|was glowing} a pale blue.{p}

The light shining from his body {f:brought out|brought out} something drifting in the air of the room.
Then the air in the room became something thick and oozing that had a presence of its own, and it clung to {f:my|my} body like sludge.
Arai's light had made the spirits {f:visible|visible}.
It hit me that all these grotesque spirits had gathered around {f:us|us} without our ever noticing.
This {f:must be|must have been} what Arai had been talking about.
The light shining from him grew steadily stronger.{p}
Then, when the light from him filled the whole room, those things vanished as if melting into the air.{p}

"Everyone, do you understand now?
Spirits are not merely something you feel. They truly exist."
No one said a word.
"If a few more spirits had gathered, even I would not have been able to drive them away."
Arai went on.
Kazama wore a serious expression.
{f:I think|I'm sure} he was considering what to make of what he'd just seen.
"Now, I'll begin my story.
It is the story of how I came to master this power."{p}

Just as he was about to begin, a window shattered with a loud crash.
A strong wind blew in through the broken glass.{p}

Outside the window floated a blue spirit like the ones Arai had shown us earlier.
But it was far bigger than the ones in the room had been. There was no comparison.
Arai was staring out the window, his face full of fear.
"Th-this has turned into a catastrophe……"
He dropped his gaze to the floor and murmured it.
A tremendous wind was raging through the room.
"I-it's hopeless……"
Arai murmured that and began to shake violently.
"Arai! Isn't there anything you can do?"
{f:I|I} said it to Arai.
But there was no trace left of his earlier composure.
His face was pale, and his eyes wouldn't focus.
Maybe he sensed how bad this was even more than {f:we|we} did.
The girls screamed.
Just like before, the room was filling with that thick, oozing stuff.
Everyone {f:seemed|seemed} to be writhing, trying to peel off the foreign matter sticking to their bodies.
The spirit floating outside the window {f:seemed|seemed} to be growing steadily bigger.
The wind raging through the room looked as if it had started to glow pale blue.
This might be the end.
{f:I|I} had a feeling it was.
How {f:did|did} it come to this?
Maybe the seven wonders of the school were something {f:we|we} should never have touched as a half-joking project.
If only I hadn't taken on this article………
Regret whirled through my head.
Everyone else {f:looked|looked} completely lost, too.
In the middle of it all, Kazama suddenly spoke up.{p}

"This is a world ordinary people shouldn't get mixed up in.
You've all gone in too deep."
Kazama slowly stood up.
"Oh well. I meant to kill this project off quietly, but it looks like that's not going to work."{p}

He turned toward the window, closed his eyes, and began to glow just like Arai.
But the light spreading around him showed it was on a completely different level.{p}

The light spreading around Kazama reached the monster floating outside the window and wrapped around it.
The monster faded away as if dissolving in the light.{p}

The meeting broke up without anyone actually saying so.
The next day, {f:I|I} told Hino we were calling it off{f:, but|, but} I couldn't explain why.
Only people who went through it could understand {f:that|that}……{p}The project was canceled.
But Hino says he's going to try it again.
There's no telling what will happen when he does.{p}

"I understand what you're saying, Arai.
But Kazama is your senior, so you really should apologize."
Arai's expression changed in an instant.
It {f:was|was} the look of someone who had never doubted for a second that {f:I|I} would take his side.
It hurt, but there was nothing I could do about it {f:now|now}.{p}

"Well, well, that's {c}{f:|} for you.
You're everything I took you for."
Kazama, by contrast, {f:was in high spirits|had cheered right up}.
"For {c}{f:|}'s sake, I'll be generous and forgive you.
Now, go on and apologize."{p}

Arai was trembling.
He seemed to be holding back a fierce rage.
"I believed in you, {a}{f:|}…… But in the end, you're just another person who has no regard for the weak."
His voice was quiet, but the anger in it came through clearly.
{f:I|I} froze.
At some point, a box cutter had appeared in Arai's hand{f:!|!}
"A-Arai★"
"I've been betrayed.
If you want me to apologize, then I'll apologize☆"
The box cutter flashed.{p}

An instant later, bright red blood spurted from Arai's wrist.
One of the girls screamed.{p}

"This is how I apologize.
That's good enough, isn't it……?"
Letting the blood gush from his wrist, Arai grinned.
Even Kazama was at a loss for words.
"Even blood like this has those who relish it.
Those types might catch the scent and come here……"
With that, Arai quietly sat down.{p}

"That won't do, {a}{f:|}.
Please go on."
It was Arai's voice.
{f:Had|Had} he read {f:my|my} mind★
As I looked into Arai's strangely glowing eyes, I began to feel I'd better not defy him.{p}In a room thick with the smell of blood, {f:we|we} decided to hear the last story.{p}

"I'd rather not."
{f:I|I} answered.
Something about it {f:felt|felt} suspicious to me.
"That won't do. Please do as I say."
Arai insisted.{p}What should I do?
Say yes
Say no
"If you insist that much, I'll do as you say."{p}

"Thank you very much."
When {f:I|I} said that, Arai thanked me with a faint smile.
I decided to trust Arai on this.
The others agreed too, more or less.
Only Kazama stayed silent.
Arai carried on, paying Kazama's silence no mind.{p}

"Then let us begin."
Arai began to focus his mind on something.
The air in the room {f:felt|felt} as if it were churning, thick and oozing.
Then the air seemed to glow blue.
"Everyone, please bow your heads and close your eyes.
No matter what happens, you must not raise your heads."
{f:I|I} closed my eyes and bowed my head.
"Those with a strong sixth sense will be able to feel the thick, oozing air in this room.
Right now, 'something' is definitely in this room.
……Even if you sense its presence, please don't panic.
{f:We|We} need only stay calm and keep still.
The spirits are clinging to your bodies, but please bear with it.
I will now drive the spirits out."
With that, Arai fell silent.{p}

{f:I|I} felt as if I were bathed in a warm light.
And I could feel the oozing stuff that had been clinging to me melting away and turning into fresh, clean air.{p}

{f:It's|It's} Kazama!
That {f:was|was} Kazama's voice!
"Don't open your eyes!"
Arai shouted the moment the scream rang out.
{f:I|I} did as he said.
"Everyone, you may open your eyes now.
{a}{f:|}, would you turn the lights on, please?"{p}

……Kazama was all right.
But…… he was staring at Arai with terror on his face.
"Kazama, what's wrong?!"
{f:I|I} asked him.{p}

"……Kazama.
You have seen something you should not have seen.
But you will not be able to tell anyone about it.
I hardly need to explain why……"
Kazama gave a small nod, lowered his eyes, and began to tremble.
"Everyone, I have driven the spirits out of this room for the time being.
But as long as we keep telling stories like these, the spirits will gather again.
Please don't let your guard down while these stories go on.
………Well then, shall we begin?"{p}

{f:I|I} looked around at everyone.
They seemed to have felt that oozing air too, and their faces were solemn.{p}

{f:I|I} looked at Kazama.
His eyes were open, but empty.
They {f:didn't seem|didn't seem} to be focused on anything.
"Kazama, what's wrong?"
Kazama was not himself at all.
……What on earth {f:had|had} he seen?
He was terrified.{p}

"{a}{f:|}, Kazama didn't do as {f:I|I} told him.
He opened his eyes back then.
He can't talk about it, and besides, you're better off not knowing."
Arai fixed his gaze on Kazama.
"He took this matter far too lightly."
Arai said it flatly.
"{a}{f:|}, there are things in this world better left unknown."
"What do you mean?"
"{a}{f:|}, it seems you're one of those worthless people too.
……If you insist that much, I'll show you what he saw.
It would be cruel to drag the others into it.
Why don't we go to a classroom nearby?"{p}

Arai got up from his seat and went out into the hallway.
{f:I|I} followed after him.
A wave of unease washed over me.
What {f:was|was} going to happen now?
{f:I|I} was starting to regret this.
{f:Wasn't I|Wasn't I} walking into something terrible, all because of some petty sense of justice?
That whiff of danger {f:I|I} had instinctively sensed from Arai back then...
Why {f:hadn't|hadn't} I trusted that feeling?
Petty common sense had gotten in the way, and I'd failed to heed the danger signal my instincts had picked up.
Arai went into a nearby classroom.
{f:I|I} was holding back the urge to run and getting ready to follow him.
But I could feel some part of me warning me to run.{p}

And then I went into the classroom Arai had entered.
To the very end, I couldn't heed the warning my instincts gave me.{p}
Deep inside, {f:I|I} could feel my fate declaring its end.{p}

"No.
I can't follow such vague instructions."
{f:I|I} said it firmly.
"D-don't say that……"
Arai's voice wavered.
Something {f:was|was} off here.
{f:I|I} decided to keep refusing, no matter what.
"When I say no, I mean no."
"But you can't!
If you don't say yes here, the story can't go on-n-n!"
At last, Arai's voice turned tearful.{p}

The lights came on.
"What's this all about?"
Arai was on the verge of tears.
"The truth is, I couldn't think of a scary story.
So I thought I'd scare you with a little trick, but……"
"And since I went and did mine first, you lost your temper. Is that it?"
Kazama nodded knowingly.
"Y-yes, that's it. I'm sorry."
The mood fell flat.
Still, Arai had shrunk into himself so much it was pitiful.
{f:Can't be helped|Oh well}.
{f:I|I} decided to throw him a lifeline.
"Well then, let's just say the fifth story is done for now.
That's all right, isn't it?"{p}

Everyone nodded.
All right, {f:now it's time for|on to} the sixth story……{p}

{f:I|I} shook my head.
I didn't want to admit it, {f:because|because} what I'd seen was too terrifying.{p}

Arai narrowed his eyes.
"Oh, that's no good.
They hate lies more than anything.
And you went and lied right in front of them."{p}

……Close to my ear, there was a sound like something creaking.
Was it the wind, or a cry?{p}

Arai grinned.
"See... it got angry and latched onto you."
Just then, I felt warm breath against my ear.
There was something behind {f:me|me}☆{p}
{f:I|I} turned around.{p}

Something I couldn't make sense of was there.
A gaki, a starving ghoul with a skull-like face.
{f:It was the same one|It was the same thing} that had been on Kazama's back!
……{f:I|I} may have screamed.
An instant later, {f:it|it} vanished.{p}

Arai laughed gleefully.
"Oh dear.
Didn't I tell you?
Once that happens, nobody can pull it off you."{p}

My body felt heavy and drained.
{f:Was|Was} this what being possessed felt like?{p}
Please make it a scary one……"{p}
